description: Build the frontend UGC page with URL input, voice/template selection, progress display, script preview, and video output. Creates a new /ugc route following existing UI patterns (dark theme, violet/pink gradients, shadcn/ui components, TanStack Query, auth via useSession).
steps: Create apps/web/src/app/ugc/page.tsx - Full UGC page with: (a) URL input field for TikTok Shop product URL, (b) Voice selection dropdown (nova, alloy, echo, fable, onyx, shimmer), (c) Template style select (pov, storytime, bold-hook, authentic), (d) 'Generate UGC Video' button that posts to /api/ugc/create then /api/ugc/:id/process, (e) Progress display showing pipeline stages (scraping, generating_script, generating_tts, generating_assets, planning_scenes, composing, completed), (f) Script preview showing hook/problem/solution/demo/socialProof/cta when available, (g) Final video download/preview link when complete, (h) Error states with retry option. Use TanStack Query useQuery for polling /api/ugc/:id status. Use sonner toast for notifications. Protect with useSession (redirect to /account/signin if not authenticated). Follow the existing dark theme pattern from upload/page.tsx and dashboard/page.tsx.

Add a navigation link to the UGC page from the dashboard. In apps/web/src/app/dashboard/page.tsx, add a link/button to /ugc (e.g., 'Create UGC Video' button in the header area alongside the existing upload button).
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /ugc shows a functional page with URL input, voice selector, template style selector, and generate button
Clicking generate with a valid URL calls POST /api/ugc/create, then POST /api/ugc/:id/process, and starts polling GET /api/ugc/:id
Progress stages update visually as the backend reports status changes
Script preview renders each section (hook, problem, solution, demo, socialProof, cta) when available
When status is 'completed', a video preview/download link is shown
Error states are handled gracefully with user-friendly messages and retry option
Page requires authentication (redirects to signin if not logged in)
Dashboard has a visible link to the UGC page
The page passes typecheck (no TypeScript errors)
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/anything-clipper && yarn workspace web typecheck
Run: cd /projects/sandbox/anything-clipper && yarn workspace web test
